outputs: liba14jna_<abi>.so (4 ABIs) - plain exported C symbols: a14_direct_add, a14_helper_mul, a14_via_init, a14_twin_echo, a14_ambiguous, a14_bootstrap_decoy, a14_bootstrap_real
liba14other_<abi>.so (4 ABIs) - the second exporter: a14_ambiguous (a real two-library ambiguity) and a14_helper_mul (the decoy the register constant must refuse)

a14-jna-classes.dex - five register shapes: A14Direct (constant at the call), A14Helper (constant from findLibraryName's fallback, uniffi's shape), A14ViaInit (the call inside a method the <clinit> runs), A14Ambiguous (process-library registration, no constant), A14Twin (no register anywhere), A14Bootstrap + A14RegisteredByBootstrap (a cross-class registration: evidence for no class)
a14-jna.apk - the dex plus liba14jna.so, liba14other.so and the libjnidispatch.so name-presence stub in all four ABIs
a14-jna-nodispatch.apk - the arm64 copies without the dispatch stub: no binding where JNA cannot load
stub_note: libjnidispatch.so in the APKs is an empty NDK-built stub: the join's requirement is name presence (a static join reads the name, not JNA's LGPL artifact).
oracle: llvm-readelf --dyn-syms: every jna_direct fn_addr equals that name's dynsym value in its own ABI's copy; asserted in-repo by tests/test_jni.py::test_a14_jna_fn_addrs_pass_the_symbol_oracle
